boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-admission, no-purchase ways to spend time at Susquehanna or nearby, with access conditions noted.

cards.title: Browse the Lore Degenstein Gallery
cards.subtitle: Charles B. Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Walk through the current exhibition with friends during gallery hours; check the page before going because the gallery closes during university breaks.
cards.short_summary: A free campus gallery visit with rotating professional and student exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The gallery states that all of its events are free and open to the public.
cards.access_notes: Open daily 11 a.m.–5 p.m.; closed during university breaks. No admission is stated for gallery events.

cards.title: Catch a movie night at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Charlie's Lounge · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Check the lounge’s weekly programming, then bring a friend for the scheduled movie rather than planning around a paid screening.
cards.short_summary: A campus movie-night option within Charlie’s free programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Charlie's Lounge provides free programming and lists movie night among its scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: For Susquehanna students; confirm the weekly schedule with Charlie’s Lounge.

cards.title: Take in an open mic at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Charlie's Lounge · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Look for an open-mic date on the lounge schedule and go to listen or participate; confirm any sign-up details with the event host.
cards.short_summary: A free student-programmed night for live student expression.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Charlie's Lounge provides free programming and lists open mic night among its scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: For Susquehanna students; availability depends on the weekly Charlie’s schedule.

cards.title: Join karaoke at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Charlie's Lounge · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Check for a scheduled karaoke night, then go with a group to sing or cheer people on; ask the host how the performance queue works.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus karaoke activity when it is scheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Charlie's Lounge provides free programming and lists karaoke night among its scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: For Susquehanna students; check Charlie’s Lounge programming before heading over.

cards.title: See a concert at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Charlie's Lounge · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Watch the lounge schedule for a concert, then arrive for the set and use the shared seating area to spend time with friends afterward.
cards.short_summary: A free campus concert option scheduled through Charlie’s Lounge.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Charlie's Lounge provides free programming and lists concerts among its scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: For Susquehanna students; concerts are scheduled events rather than a daily offering.

cards.title: Make something at Charlie's craft night
cards.subtitle: Charlie's Lounge · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Check the weekly program for a craft night and arrive ready to use the materials supplied for that scheduled activity.
cards.short_summary: A free, hands-on campus activity when offered in Charlie’s.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Charlie's Lounge provides free programming and lists craft night among its scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: For Susquehanna students; confirm the event date and any participation details with Charlie’s Lounge.

cards.title: Go to a slam-poetry event at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Charlie's Lounge · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Look for a slam-poetry event on the lounge schedule and attend as an audience member or ask the organizer about participating.
cards.short_summary: A free spoken-word event listed in Charlie’s programming.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Charlie's Lounge provides free programming and lists slam poetry among its scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: For Susquehanna students; confirm event scheduling and participation rules in advance.

cards.title: See a comedy show at Charlie's
cards.subtitle: Charlie's Lounge · Degenstein Campus Center
cards.notes: Check for a scheduled comedy show and make it a low-key group plan; follow any event instructions posted by the student organizers.
cards.short_summary: A free on-campus comedy event when it appears on the lounge calendar.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna says Charlie's Lounge provides free programming and lists comedy shows among its scheduled events.
cards.access_notes: For Susquehanna students; scheduled programming varies throughout the week.

cards.title: Attend a Seavey Reading Series event
cards.subtitle: Susquehanna University campus
cards.notes: Check the arts calendar for the next reading, then come hear a visiting writer; verify the location and start time before you go.
cards.short_summary: Free public readings by visiting writers at Susquehanna.
cards.evidence_claim: Susquehanna states that internationally recognized writers visit for free public readings through the Seavey Reading Series.
cards.access_notes: Public reading dates and venues vary; consult Susquehanna’s arts and events calendar.

cards.entity_name: Shikellamy State Park Unreserved Picnic Pavilion
cards.title: Claim an unreserved pavilion at Shikellamy
cards.subtitle: Shikellamy State Park · Marina or Overlook section
cards.notes: Bring your own picnic or simply meet at an unreserved pavilion; use it first-come, first-served rather than reserving a paid pavilion.
cards.short_summary: A free outdoor gathering spot in a nearby Pennsylvania state park.
cards.evidence_claim: DCNR states that unreserved picnic pavilions at Shikellamy State Park are free on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: Picnicking at Shikellamy State Park — Pennsylvania DCNR
cards.access_notes: Pavilions may be reserved for a fee, but unreserved pavilions are free first-come, first-served.
